title: Tanium security advisory (AV26-1097)
content_md: Serial number: AV26-1097 Date: October 28, 2026 As of October 27, 2026, Tanium is affected by vulnerabilities in the following products: Certificate Manager Prior to 1.17.417 Prior to 1.18.368 Prior to 1.22.119 Endpoint Configuration Toolset Solution Prior to 1.51.60 Prior to 1.59.50 Prior to 1.71.25 Enforce Prior to 2.10.778 Prior to 2.9.736 Prior to 3.0.373 Provision Prior to 1.17.150 Prior to 1.23.161 Prior to 1.24.199 Threat Response Prior to 4.12.349 Prior to 4.17.327 Prior to 4.9.476 end-user-cx Multiple versions index-cx Multiple versions The Cyber Centre encourages users and administrators to review the provided web link and apply any necessary updates as they become available.
